answer: The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the plume queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 380 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tide. A farm of 296 pays that 33 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
